sn_aia_tool.description: Returns open follow-up actions on the manager's requests (or owned by the manager) that are overdue or due within the given number of days, with owner, due date, overdue flag and a link.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"days","description":"Number of days ahead to include (1-60). Default 7.","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: get_followups_due
